evidence: Cic. Fam. 11.1.1: heri vesperī apud mē Hirtius fuit (Lewis & Short s.v. heri)
terms.comment: Of the evening before, up to bedtime; of the night itself, proximā nocte. Heri has a short final i (see yesterday evening).
